normal.title: Scene 1: Nominal Poisson Traffic
normal.subtitle: Steady normal baseline arrivals demonstrating zero false alarms on stationary Poisson traffic
normal.highlight: Zero False Alarms on Stationary Poisson Traffic
normal.explanation: Standard threshold detectors often flag natural discrete Poisson fluctuations as anomalies. PulseWatch estimates adaptive baseline dispersion (phi = 1.00) and achieves zero false positives across 12 continuous minutes (2,183 requests).

known_limitations: Offline synthetic monitoring cannot infer external causes, intent, or system failures.
Deduplication is bounded in memory; high volumes may trigger LRU eviction.
Windows overlapping unknown gaps are treated as unobserved rather than assumed zero.
Tail probability calculations are empirical approximations under Poisson/Negative-Binomial dispersion models.

gap.title: Scene 2: Network Outage & Coverage Gap
gap.subtitle: 1,000s collector outage (>900s threshold) isolated as unknown gap with explicit abstention
gap.highlight: Defensible Abstention Prevents Telemetry Resume False Alarms
gap.explanation: When log shippers crash, naive moving-average detectors treat unobserved silence as zero traffic and fire false alerts when telemetry resumes. PulseWatch isolates the 1,001s gap, measures 19.3% coverage (below the 40% defensible threshold), and explicitly abstains.

data_notices: Detector abstained from decision: Coverage (19.3%) or observation duration (240s) below minimum defensible threshold.

surge.title: Scene 3: Genuine 90s API Surge
surge.subtitle: Multi-client surge on /api/v1/items/search localized across 10s, 60s, and 300s scales
surge.highlight: Multi-Scale Surge Localization & Second-Pass Contributor Attribution
surge.explanation: A genuine 90-second surge (25 req/s peak vs 2.00 req/s baseline, Z = 125.98) fired across 10s, 60s, and 300s scales. Boundary trimming isolates the exact 90s active excess (+2,070 requests), while second-pass replay extracts the concentrated route (/api/v1/items/search) and broad caller distribution.

descriptive_pattern.rationale: Sustained elevated volume lasting 90s across multi-scale windows.

dedup.title: Scene 4: Duplicate Replay Attack / Storm
dedup.subtitle: 235 exact duplicate proxy log replays filtered by 4-level BLAKE2b identity deduplication
dedup.highlight: Single-Pass Identity Deduplication Suppresses Phantom Spike
dedup.explanation: Proxy retry storms replay identical request identities, creating a phantom +49% volume spike (715 raw lines vs 480 unique). PulseWatch's 4-level BLAKE2b hierarchy removes all 235 exact duplicates before temporal aggregation, yielding 0 false alarms.

regime.title: Bonus Scene: Ambiguous Regime Level Shift
regime.subtitle: Permanent rate elevation (2 -> 16 req/s) flagged as level_shift_candidate with asymmetry warning
regime.highlight: Regime Asymmetry Check Distinguishes Scaling Steps from Transient Bursts
regime.explanation: When traffic permanently steps up from 2 to 16 req/s, PulseWatch detects significant first-half vs second-half asymmetry (ratio 0.15), classifies the incident as level_shift_candidate, downgrades baseline reliability to LOW, and guides operators to confirm whether an intentional scaling event occurred.

worldcup98.title: Scene 5: FIFA World Cup 1998 Historical Trace Validation
worldcup98.subtitle: Authentic 1998 HTTP server traces scaling up to 210,287 requests per 15-minute window
worldcup98.highlight: Scale-Invariant Stability Across Real Historical HTTP Workloads
worldcup98.explanation: Evaluated on three authentic 15-minute slices from the 1998 FIFA World Cup dataset (Day 20: 19.25 req/s, Day 46: 237.58 req/s, Day 78 Final: 144.02 req/s). PulseWatch maintained zero false alarms across all authentic background windows. Separate semi-synthetic perturbation experiments inject controlled bursts onto these traces with manifest-tracked ground truth.

ablations.title: Scene 6: Empirical Architectural Ablations
ablations.subtitle: Five controlled ablation experiments quantifying each subsystem's causal contribution
ablations.highlight: Empirical Proof of Every Pipeline Stage
ablations.explanation: Disabling individual subsystems produces measurable regressions: omitting dispersion scaling inflates false alarms on overdispersed traffic (19.2 -> 136.8 FP/day); disabling sticky masking allows surges to contaminate the baseline; single-scale scanning degrades localization IoU.
